component.name: Fretman
component.summary: Fretboard Trainer: learn the notes and chords on guitar and bass

description.p: Quick multiple-choice drills for the fretboard: see a fret and name the note, see a note and find it, recognize chord shapes and name them, and find a note's octave on another string.

A Duolingo-style learning path starts on the low E string and works through every string, the octave shapes, open chords, power chords, barre chords and drop D. Guitar (6 or 7 strings) and bass (4 to 6), with tuning presets, sharps or flats, and a left-handed fretboard.
Everything stays on your computer: no accounts, no analytics.
